$description: Tier 3: the Instacart logo's own colours, read from the official logo SVGs (brand/brand.md, Logo). They are artwork colours, not UI roles, so they do not change with the theme: the caller picks the logo tone that suits the background. Emitted without the `component` prefix: --logo-kale.

kale.$description: Wordmark text in the Full Color Dark logo (#003D29). For light backgrounds.

cashew.$description: Wordmark text in the Full Color Light logo (#FAF1E5). For Kale or dark backgrounds.

white.$description: The Single Color White logo (#FFFFFF), for photos and colours where the full-colour logo is not approved.
